title: Moving Into Home
source: 2026 big-game spot: a family's move told on an assistant's screen
description: A screen-led story where a parent types requests to an AI assistant while parent and child talk off screen, turning an empty new house into home, with a home-video memory montage and a payoff where the generated picture becomes real.
prompt30: Make a 30 s film from the new-home template for Lumen Aria, an AI assistant that helps a family make a new house feel like home.
